'''Brandon Cheek''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Augusta tournament]] on 30 December 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base X-wings]], according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1583">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-augusta-ga-12-30-paul-md1583/ augusta-ga-12-30-paul-m], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-augusta-ga-12-30-paul-md1583/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
